visualCharacteristics.layout: Bordered fixed-layout grid with header row; empty cells after a filled cell extend it (colspan)
visualCharacteristics.notes: Bordered comparison table: header Tools | Reference Software | Standard Software | Premium Software, a row of linked software names, then a row Software Package Manager | NXP Support | SafeAssure NDA group with spanning cells; beige header/footer cells.

contentPattern.structure: header row then data rows, same cell count per row; leave a cell empty to merge it into the cell on its left

reuseGuidance: Use for small comparison grids; use table-parametric for large part data.
